card.text: F6 star in Phoenix, 123 parsecs away, circled every 23 hours by a planet ten times Jupiter's mass.

introduction.text: WASP-18 is an F-type star a little larger and hotter than the Sun. Its massive planet WASP-18b orbits so close that it circles in under a day.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of Gaia's spectrum of the star. No surface picture exists.
